title: Shard-local one-hop traversal
statement: The system shall serve a one-hop traversal from a node with up to 10,000 incident edges by reading from 1 shard, within 20 ms at the 99th percentile.
rationale: Range-partitioned ordered keys with edges stored under their node's key prefix make neighbourhood reads a single range scan.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tracing shows MATCH (n {id:$id})-[e:T]->(m) RETURN e for a node with ≤ 10,000 edges reads adjacency from exactly 1 shard.
Over 30 minutes at 70% of rated throughput, p99 latency for returning the edges (not neighbour properties) of nodes with ≤ 1,000 edges is ≤ 20 ms.

source: Design recommendation 2026-10-05 — PO to confirm thresholds
